column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the mechanical properties record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Performance(PerfRegistry), linking mechanical specs to performance metrics.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing DeviceIdentity(DevRegistry), associating mechanical data with a specific device.
A NUMERIC(5,2) describing actuation force (in grams) for keys or switches.
A NUMERIC(3,1) showing total travel distance (in mm) for keys or buttons.
A VARCHAR(40) naming the specific switch variant (e.g., Membrane, Mechanical, Optical, Magnetic).
A BIGINT indicating the rated switch durability (e.g., total actuations).
A SMALLINT counting how many keys might exhibit ‘ghosting’ if pressed simultaneously.
A VARCHAR(35) describing the rollover spec (e.g., 2KRO, 6KRO, NKRO).
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring the consistency in switch actuation force or performance.
A NUMERIC(4,1) quantifying the effective impact of ghosting (on a scale or percentage).
A NUMERIC(3,2) indicating key chatter or bounce (in ms or a relative measure).
A NUMERIC(3,1) showing at what point (in mm) the key actuates from the top of its travel.
A NUMERIC(3,1) specifying the reset point (in mm) where the switch deactivates on release.
A NUMERIC(3,1) measuring the tactile bump position (in mm) in a tactile switch.
A NUMERIC(3,1) for the total travel distance (in mm) if fully bottomed out.
An enum (StabRattle_enum) indicating stabilizer rattle level (None, Minimal, Moderate).
A VARCHAR(30) naming the stabilizer type (e.g., PCB Mount, Screw-in, Plate Mount).
A NUMERIC(3,1) for the keycap thickness (in mm).
A VARCHAR(35) specifying the keycap material (ABS, PBT, etc.).
A VARCHAR(40) describing how the legends are applied (e.g., Double Shot, Dye Sub, Laser Etched).
A SMALLINT indicating the built-in keyboard angle or tilt (in degrees).
A BOOLEAN stating whether a wrist rest is integrated or included.
A SMALLINT measuring the palm rest angle (in degrees), if applicable.
A SMALLINT providing an ergonomic rating (on a defined scale).
